title: 第4章 你只是失去了一颗树，但将迎来整片森林！-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》
content:
第(1/3)页

    王小晨突然感到一阵恶心，她捂着胸口趴在床边咳嗽起来。

    暖心大男孩魏沐立刻凑上前去关心：“小晨，你怎么了？”

    王小晨没有说话，她用带着一丝幽怨的眼神瞪着罪魁祸首。

    “你还好意思说？我刚才不要，你非要。”

    “非要什么？”

    魏沐继续装傻。

    说到这里，王小晨脸腾地一下红了。

    她88年生人，今年才20岁，哪见过这个？

    刚才那几下子，让她嗓子疼到现在。

    “你学坏了！！”

    她以前哪受过这种苦，今天也不知道怎么了，迷迷糊糊就从了他的意。

    可能是出于愧疚？

    毕竟俩人马上就要分手。

    这年头还没流行分手炮这个词，王小晨也不知道怎么形容现在的感受。

    魏沐闻言，脸上露出恰到好处的尴尬，抬手挠了挠后脑勺：“我以为你会喜欢。”

    说完话，一脸歉意的看着对方。

    这个时候千言万语，不如表情有说服力。

    魏沐上辈子就是靠着这副看狗都深情的眼神大杀四方，不知道拿下多少姐姐和妹妹。

    “我不....”

    后者刚要反驳，又注意到对方那副眼神，湿漉漉的，仿佛蒙上了一层水汽。

    于是她只好把到嘴边的话咽了回去。

    过了一会，魏沐从床头拿起一包烟就要点上。

    王小晨疑惑的看着他：“你怎么又开始抽烟了？不是说好戒了吗”

    “哦。我没想抽烟....”

    他确实没想抽烟，事实上，他上辈子就很少抽烟。

    只是现在这种情况，不拿出来一根烟总觉得少了点什么。

    .........

    下午，校园不远处的快捷酒店门口。

    一对外形出众、长得跟明星似的男女紧紧相拥，女孩的指尖用力到几乎要掐进男孩的后背。

    半晌，才缓缓松开，各自后退一步，转身，朝着不同的方向离去，没有再说一句告别。

    魏沐回校园，而王小晨还约了经纪人。

    作为还没毕业便被经纪公司签约的潜力新人，王晓晨去年便拍摄了师哥陆易主演的《苏东坡》

    今年一月份又客串出演了胡哥版《射雕英雄传》，在里面饰演黄药师的挚爱妻子冯蘅。

    放在上戏同龄人里面，绝对算是佼佼者。

    而且她还很年轻。

    别看她现在是大四，实际上她今年才20岁。

    也就是说，她16岁便考上国内三大戏剧学院之一的上戏。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wang Xiaochen suddenly felt nauseous. She covered her chest and lay beside the bed coughing.

Wei Mu, a warm-hearted boy, immediately stepped forward to care: "Xiaochen, what's wrong with you?"

Wang Xiaochen said nothing, she stared at the culprit with a hint of resentment in her eyes.

"You still have the nerve to say it? I didn't want it just now, but you insist on it."

"What do you need?"

Wei Mu continued to act stupid.

Speaking of this, Wang Xiaochen’s face turned red.

She was born in 1988 and is only 20 years old this year. How have you seen this before?

Those few moments ago gave her a sore throat.

“You’re a bad learner!!”

She had never suffered like this before, and she didn’t know what happened today, so she just obeyed his wishes in a daze.

Maybe out of guilt?

After all, the two of them are about to break up.

The term breakup has not become popular these days, and Wang Xiaochen doesn’t know how to describe his current feelings.

When Wei Mu heard this, his face showed just the right amount of embarrassment, he raised his hand and scratched the back of his head: "I thought you would like it."

After finishing speaking, he looked at the other person with an apologetic look.

At this time, words are not as convincing as expressions.

In his last life, Wei Mu relied on his eyes that looked as affectionate as a dog to kill everyone, and he won countless sisters and sisters.

"I don't..."

Just as the latter was about to retort, he noticed the other person's eyes, which were wet, as if covered with a layer of moisture.

So she had no choice but to swallow the words that came to her lips.

After a while, Wei Mu picked up a pack of cigarettes from the bedside and was about to light it.

Wang Xiaochen looked at him doubtfully: "Why did you start smoking again? Didn't you say you quit?"

"Oh. I didn't want to smoke..."

He really didn’t want to smoke. In fact, he rarely smoked in his previous life.

It’s just that in this situation, if I don’t take out a cigarette, I always feel like something is missing.

…........

In the afternoon, at the entrance of the Express Hotel not far from the campus.

A pair of outstanding-looking men and women who looked like celebrities hugged each other tightly. The girl’s fingertips were so hard that they almost pinched the boy’s back.

After a long while, they slowly let go, each took a step back, turned around, and left in different directions without saying goodbye.

Wei Mu returned to campus, and Wang Xiaochen also made an appointment with his agent.

As a potential newcomer who was signed by a brokerage company before graduation, Wang Xiaochen filmed "Su Dongpo" starring his senior brother Lu Yi last year

In January this year, she guest-starred in Hu Ge's version of "The Legend of the Condor Heroes", playing Huang Yaoshi's beloved wife Feng Heng.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Outside of the peers in the theater, he is definitely the best.

And she is still very young.

Although she is a senior now, she is actually only 20 years old this year.

In other words, at the age of 16, she was admitted to Shangxi Opera, one of the three major drama academies in China.
